notes.text: Timnath-heres or Timnath-serah =" portion of the sun" or "abundant portion" a city given to Joshua as a inheritance in the mountains of Ephraim on the north of the hill of Gaash where he was buried
Gaash =" quaking" a mountain of Ephraim where Joshua was buried
